==About==

Right-clicking {{i|Any Potato}} and selecting "Split" will divide your Potato into 6x {{i|Potato Chunk}}s which can be used for re-planting. It only takes a single Potato Chunk to Plant a {{i|Tilled Field}} at '''ANY''' % [[Tilled Field#Upkeep|Upkeep]], which makes Potato Chunks useful for resetting a Tilled Field which has been damaged by a {{i|Crow}}. A Potato Chunk '''CANNOT''' be used for Gluttony.
